WHAT WE DO

Our core try-on tech

From virtual try-on generation to store integrations, we deliver outcomes that move your store forward.

Virtual Try-On API

Let shoppers see dresses, kurtas, and more on their own photo with one API call.

64-Variation Engine

Two sets of 32 variations per product, with new batches generated on demand.

Pattern Analysis & Enhancement

Each selected variation is cropped, pattern-analyzed, and enhanced before rendering.

Usage Metering & Billing

Every billable image is metered, with invoices, payments, and balance in your dashboard.

Analytics & Reliability

Track request volume, success rate, latency, and errors in real time.

E-commerce Integrations

Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, or your custom store with an API key and a few lines of code.

Made for every

fashion category

Typical projects

From virtual try-on generation to store integrations, we deliver outcomes that move your store forward.

  • Adding try-on to Shopify stores
  • Generating 64-variation batches for catalogs
  • Custom try-on flows for D2C brands
  • Usage dashboards and billing setup
  • Image pipeline tuning for ethnic wear
  • Multi-category try-on rollouts

How we work

A process built for results

Clear milestones, constant communication, and zero hand-waving. Here’s how we get from catalog to try-on.

Step 01
Discovery & Success Criteria

We review your catalog, pick a pilot category, and define clear metrics for success.

Step 02
Connect Store + Variations

We connect your store with an API key and generate the first 64 variations. No surprises down the road.

Step 03
Pilot + Test + Security Review

We run a live try-on pilot on your products, test quality and speed, and review image security at every stage. You see results weekly.

Step 04
Launch + Monitor + Iterate

Go live confidently. We monitor quality, usage and latency, and optimize based on data.

Automations that ship & keep running.
